objective: Build and evaluate a two-stage text-space narrative retrieval pipeline for NL prefix-latent scenarios. Stage 1 trains a multi-view contrastive retriever in OpenAI embedding space using same-window narrative positives and hard negatives so similarity means same or compatible market condition rather than generic wording. Stage 2 uses frozen-SNI historical backtest preference over retrieved supports to rank candidates whose existing top3/90 rollout best matches realized held-out paths. Keep the current paper/demo top3/90 assembly and frozen SNI rollout unchanged until verifier-backed promotion.

active_retrieval_objective.name: two_stage_text_space_retriever

stage_1.name: multi_view_contrastive_text_retriever
stage_1.goal: Stay in OpenAI embedding space and learn a financial-condition metric from direct Codex/GPT-authored multi-view narratives. Same historical window across narrative styles is positive; semantically similar but directionally incompatible windows are hard negatives.

stage_2.name: frozen_sni_backtest_preference_reranker
stage_2.goal: Use frozen SNI only as a teacher/evaluator: retrieve support candidates, run the unchanged component-preserving top3/90 rollout, compare with realized next-30-day historical paths, and train/evaluate pairwise preferences that rank better supports above worse supports.

active_retrieval_objective.primary_success_criterion: support coherence and fixed-start narrative conditionality improve over raw semantic retrieval while historical CRPS/Energy/coverage remain competitive with the current baseline guardrails

rich_institutional_windowing.description: Use half-overlap 30-day prefixes for expensive rich institutional narratives.

sparse_user_windowing.description: Generate short user-like narratives per historical date/window inside the TestFlight slice.

testflight_result.quality_tradeoff: Retracted: the local schema/retrieval TestFlight used deterministic/template prose and is invalid for narrative-regeneration, retrieval, conditionality, smoke, or mechanism evidence.

codex_authored_review_result.note: This corrected 980a TestFlight regenerated independent Codex-authored multi-format narratives with an institutional risk-committee note and evidence-dominant scenario titles. Earlier packets are superseded: 974a rendered local views from one generated caption; 975a had instruction-like sparse prompts; 976a had one internal support-system reference; 977a lacked an institutional note; 978a exposed weekly-monitor factor-list warnings; 979a still used bank-stress wording and over-broad source labels.

retracted_981_result.reason: 981 consumed a local deterministic/template EpisodeCardV3 corpus. All retrieval, embedding, and scenario-level conclusions from that corpus are invalid for final assessment and must be redone from direct Codex/GPT-authored multi-format cards.

incumbent_to_protect.name: Nearest similar regimes / Main-regime view: top3/90

phase_plan.name: corpus_quality_and_multi_view_episode_cards
phase_plan.goal: Audit the existing self-supervised captions for factor-list bias, sparse-query coverage, mechanism coverage, and leakage, then regenerate direct Codex/GPT-authored multi-view episode cards without editing incumbent caption files.

phase_plan.name: local_narrative_to_narrative_retrieval
phase_plan.goal: Compare incumbent memory retrieval, dense text retrieval, lexical/claim retrieval, and hybrid episode retrieval on fully specified and sparse risk-manager queries, using only direct Codex/GPT-authored or trusted human/source narrative text.

phase_plan.name: scenario_level_testflight
phase_plan.goal: Pipe candidate supports through the existing top3/90 component-preserving frozen SNI rollout and compare against the incumbent with matched starts, narratives, seeds, and sample counts.

phase_plan.name: fixed_start_conditionality_lift_over_start_only
phase_plan.goal: Measure whether episode-level narrative retrieval changes supports and generated scenario distributions beyond a start-only terminal-state support baseline for the same accepted starts. Treat CRPS, Energy, and coverage as quality guardrails, not the main differentiator.

phase_plan.name: codex_agentic_rerank_and_online_enrichment
phase_plan.goal: If pure local semantic retrieval is not good enough, use Codex/agentic qualitative adjudication over a shortlist and/or timestamp-safe online context enrichment to preserve start compatibility while improving narrative lift.

phase_plan.name: product_readout_and_promotion_review
phase_plan.goal: If a selector passes, produce a risk-manager-facing readout that explains matched historical episode narratives, explicit versus inferred channels, support checks, and baseline-relative scenario distribution changes.
